frequency_question: How often do structural frictions or operational feedback loops successfully block or prevent a central bank from implementing a planned liquidity-absorbing instrument once signaled or prepared?
membership_rule: Includes any instance where a central bank considered or prepared a liquidity-draining reserve requirement tool; excludes normal open market operations.
window: Any multi-month window within the last 25 years.

cases.name: RBI incremental CRR (past episodes of liquidity absorption)
PBoC reserve requirement ratio hike for liquidity management
ECB minimum reserve requirement ratio adjustment

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named instances; represents the population of similar central bank liquidity-absorption tool deployments.
known_gaps: Internal legal challenges or technical glitches that may have been aborted before public announcement are unrecorded.
skeleton: Central bank administrative liquidity tool deployments since 2000 across major jurisdictions facing sudden excess liquidity surges.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 documented major attempts by central banks possessing statutory authority to deploy reserve ratio adjustments.
validity_reason: Central banking statutory powers and operational frameworks regarding reserve ratios remain stable over multi-year horizons.
